comments.body:

Skills: Search 2, Art 4, German
Other: Adventure fame 1800

comments.author: Mei Hua
comments.body:
I got this quest and endorsement a couple of weeks ago. Check to see if you have pre-discovered the "Annunciation". I had discovered it during a low level art map quest. Here is the mediator text of the Madonna and Child quest which I think supports this:

You've been specifically requested by an individual in Rome for this job, most likely because it's widely known now that you discovered that painting of the Annunciation. This client would like...

comments.author: Ogie
comments.body: Just did this one. Pre-req is "The Annunciation - an altar piece by Simone Martini". Got it after 20 or so QMPs. German, either you or an Aide is NOT required. Since no "reading" is required, Body Language worked just fine.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: If you use x1 Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers for Job Endorsement, the NPC named Molina (Spanish flag NPC; three trading caravels) sailing around Naples gives this job card. It can be easier to do than the quest if you're in a hurry. Hope this helps. Cheers.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: I received this card from Pierre Failu, a French flag NPC fleet that sails in the Gulf of Thailand and seems to spawn from Gia Dinh. It doesn't seem to be recorded elsewhere yet, so I hope this info helps some!

comments.author: HerbertHin
comments.body: Also given by Montessinos, Italian fleet between the islands south of Genoa.
